continuity: Geometry and timing determine acceleration; actual force inventories test whether a circle can be sustained; gravitational field introduces centre distance; the gravity-only circular condition selects speed/period; controlled computational comparisons separate algebraic verification from evidence. Synthesis and mixed exercises return to the opening questions. No energy, general Kepler derivation, angular momentum, rotating-frame mechanics, calculus or orbit integration prerequisites imported.

coverage.L03: Pair recipients, spherical scope, field/altitude, support vs gravity, dominant fixed-source orbit, hand predictions. Exercises6–8.
coverage.L04: Explicit input domain, independent benchmark, array/scalar controls, labels, model vs observation, limitations of coarse Moon values. Exercises8–10 plus2hour investigation.
coverage.L05: Cross-scale synthesis, ten-minute misconception audit, ten cumulative exercises with hints/worked feedback, on-page reference, identical dedicated web reference and two-pagePDF, conclusion/handover.
